title: Open Trestle route inventory identity result v1
description: Content-free structural identity report for one decoded runtime route inventory. This schema does not authorize provider execution, prove route reachability, bind a runtime policy, or mint semantic authority.

route_record_identities.description: Canonical sorted route registry record identities from the decoded inventory. Validation does not prove eligibility, availability, or policy approval.

$comment: Trusted consumers must also check route_count equals the array length and must not treat this JSON as policy binding, reachability, health, quality, execution authorization, or live conformance.
